Question Choices: Select True or False of the statement "Changing the order of multiplying length, width, and height changes the final volume." ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Solution: Multiplication is commutative and associative. Reordering length, width and height keeps the same product and therefore the same volume. FALSE.

Question Choices: Select which of the following gives the same volume? ~~6x4x9 | 9x4x6 | 4x9x6 | All-of-the-above~~
Solution: 6×4×9=216;9×4×6=216;4×9×6=216. All products have the same factors and give the same volume.

Question Choices: Fill: A container is measured as 8 m long, 2 m wide and 5 m high. The volume is __ cubic meters (m³)
Hints: Multiply length, width and height, using the same length unit.
Solution: Base area = 8 × 2 = 16 square meters. Volume = base area × height = 16 × 5 = 80 cubic meters.

Question Choices: Fill: A box has a volume of 120 cm³. Its length is 5 cm and width is 4 cm. The height is __ cm.
Hints: Divide the volume by the base area to find height.
Solution: Base area = 5 × 4 = 20 cm². Height = volume ÷ base area = 120 ÷ 20 = 6 cm. Check: 5 × 4 × 6 = 120 cm³.

Question Choices: A water trough is 10 m long, 3 m wide and 2 m high. The volume of the water trough is __ cubic meters (m³)
Hints: Multiply length, width and height, using the same length unit.
Solution: Base area = 10 × 3 = 30 square meters. Volume = base area × height = 30 × 2 = 60 cubic meters.
